# VRTracking

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

Head and hands of a headset in stage space, written by VRPlayerInput from VRInput or by a test.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `focused` | `bool` | a running, focused session: poses can be trusted |
| `head` | `VRPose` | head pose (valid, position, rotation) |
| `hands` | `VRTracking::Hand[2]` | per side (VRInput::left / right): pose, velocity, angular_velocity (stage space), grip, trigger |

## Notes

On VR players. The nested VRTracking::Hand is a plain struct of this component, not a component.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: PlayerViewpoint, VRBody, VRHands. Written by: PlayerSpawn, VRPlayerInput. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeVRPlayer) | empty tracking of the VR player |
| [PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | view filter only |
| [VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | focused, head pose |
| [VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md) | system | Host | **read** | step | of the hand's player: focused, the controller's pose, velocities, grip, trigger |
| [VRPlayerInput](../systems/VRPlayerInput.md) | system | Host | **write** | tick | focused, head, both hands' pose, velocities, grip, trigger overwritten |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md)**
  - None beyond the context variables.
- **[VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md)**
  - Teleports the player's Jolt body by the head's motion each frame (`BodyInterface::SetPosition`, activated).
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
- **[VRPlayerInput](../systems/VRPlayerInput.md)**
  - None beyond the components (keeps its own play time, summed dt, for `last_action`).
